ValidationRule.description: Prevents a user from entering a Targeted Ask Date that is after the Drive Date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ( Targeted_Ask_Date__c > Drive_Date__c && NOT(ISBLANK(Targeted_Ask_Date__c)) && RecordType.Name = "Mobile Opp"&& Bypass_Validation_Rule__c == FALSE && Is_Template__c != True )&& ( ISCHANGED(Targeted_Ask_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(Drive_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Targeted Ask Date cannot be after the Drive Date.
